PCSO RELIEF DRIVE

Personnel of the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) conduct relief operations for families affected by Super Typhoon Uwan in Northern Luzon, with prepositioned goods across its North Luzon branches to ensure immediate aid delivery.

With help from the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP), PCSO teams prepared and sent ‘Charitimbas’ and essential relief goods to communities affected by the typhoon.

“STL-Authorized Agent Corporations (STL-AACs) also supported the initiative by preparing additional food and water supplies,” the agency said. (📷: PCSO) | via Jel Santos
